div.head: Ine 70.1
div.ab: Æt X hidum to fostre X fata huniges, CCC hlafa, XII ambres Wilisc ealoð, XXX hlutres, II eald hryþeru oððe X weþeras, X gés (⁊) XX henna, X cysas, amber fulne butran, V leaxas ⁊ XX (pund)wæga fodres ⁊ C æla.

Æt X hidum to fostre X fata hunies, CCC hlafa, XII ambra Wilisc ealað, XXX hluttres, tu eald hriðeru oððe X weðeras, X gees, XX henna, X cesas, amber fulne buteran, V leaxas, XX pundwæga foðres ⁊ hundteontig æla.

De X hidis ad corredium debent reddi decem dolia mellis, CCC panes, duodecim ambre ceruisie Wylisce, XXX hluttres, duo ueteres boues uel decem arietes, gallinę uiginti, casei decem, plena ambra butiri, salmones quinque, uiginti pondia fodri et centum anguille.

Æt X hidum to fostre X fata hunies, CCC hlafa, XII ambra wilesc ealað, XXX hluttres, tu eald hriðeru oððe X weðeras, X gees, XX henna, X cesas, amber fulne buteran, V leaxas, XX pundwæga foðres ⁊ hundteonig æla.

For 10 hides, food render [to the lord] should be 10 vats of honey, 300 loaves, 12 pails of Welsh ale, 30 of clear ale, two full-grown cows or 10 wethers, 10 geese, 20 hens, 10 cheeses, a full pail of butter, 5 salmon, 20 pound-weights of fodder and 100 eels.

10 vats of honey, 300 loaves, 12 ambers of Welsh ale, 30 ambers of clear ale, 2 full-grown cows or 10 wethers, 10 geese, 20 hens, 10 cheeses, a full amber of butter, 5 salmon, 20 pounds of fodder, and 100 eels shall be paid as food rent from every 10 hides.

As a food-rent from 10 hides: 10 vats of honey, 300 loaves, 12 “ambers” of Welsh ale, 30 of clear ale, 2 full-grown cows, or 10 wethers, 10 geese, 20 hens, 10 cheeses, an “amber” full of butter, 5 salmon, 20 pounds of fodder and 100 eels.

Von 10 Hiden [zahle der Beliehene dem Grundherrn] zum Unterhalt [als Jahreszins] 10 Fässer Honig, 300 Brote, 12 Eimer Wälschen Bieres, 30 hellen [Bieres], 2 ausgewachsene Rinder oder 10 Widder, 10 Gänse, 20 Hennen, 10 Käse, einen Eimer voll Butter, 5 Lachse, 20 Wispel Futter und 100 Aale.

From 10 hides [let the tenant pay the landlord] for provision [as yearly rent] 10 vats of honey, 300 loaves, 12 ambers of Welsh ale, 30 of clear [ale], 2 full-grown cattle or 10 wethers, 10 geese, 20 hens, 10 cheeses, an amber full of butter, 5 salmon, 20 weys of fodder and 100 eels.
div.note: Liebermann translates “Wispel”, a German measure of about 24 bushels.
